statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly227 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, let r_T count those containing actual triangle T and put d_T=6-r_T. All deficiencies are zero, one, two or three. If a,b,c count deficiency-one, deficiency-two and deficiency-three triangles, respectively, then a+2b+3c=24 and precisely the following necessary population ranges hold: c=0 with 1<=b<=8 and a=24-2b; c=1 with 0<=b<=5 and a=21-2b; or c=2 with b in {0,1} and a=18-2b. No c>=3 occurs. This does not assert realizability of a listed population, exclude count227 or resolve the target.
